title: Run a durable local independently accepted spec/development/test pipeline
acceptance_criteria: Installation-owned exact task policy and owner-bound continuation keep immutable criteria and fresh authority distinct from mutable stage projection
Host checkpoints and canonical stable input manifests bind fresh executor/reviewer instances; stale or forged model/card outputs cannot advance stages
Bounded rejection routes preserve history, independent spec/development/test acceptance and actual host test evidence
Durable local watch controller refills up to two independent authorized tasks without a chat, respecting component locks, limits and unknown-effect fencing
Trusted host commit/push/PR creation persists effect intents and reconciles unknown outcomes without blind replay; reviewable PR includes exact task marker
Portable process containment, private state, pins, stripped child token variables and explicit capability limits preserve legacy executor and postmerge contracts
Independent stages, exact-head/base PR and exact-main postmerge acceptance precede publisher-driven Issue16 closure; awaiting_pr is not Done
